Everything in your feed is from someone you follow. Your friends are the algo What you won't find: - ads - ai slop - location tracking or user profiling - harvesting your art or any other data for training ai

records.name: TJENIVO
records.tagline: Post tasks and find local help in Norway, on web and iOS
records.description: TJENIVO connects adults in Norway for small jobs such as moving, cleaning and furniture assembly. Post tasks or find local work on web and iOS with one account. Norway only, 18+. Free download; task prices and fees are shown before payment.

records.name: Karnataka LandGrid
records.tagline: Karnataka Survey Number Map with Hissa
records.description: Karnataka survey numbers and field boundaries on satellite imagery for all 31 districts, with taluk, village and extent in acres and guntas. In English and Kannada.

records.name: Hidden Cam Detect
records.tagline: Check a room for hidden cameras, honestly
records.description: Hotel room, short-term rental, or your own home — Hidden Cam Detect sweeps the space for hidden cameras, microphones and tracking devices. And when something turns up, it helps you walk to it. SEE WHAT'S ON THE NETWORK Most hidden cameras need Wi-Fi to be useful. The app lists what's connected and tells you what each thing actually is — "IP camera, known brand" instead of "192.168.1.42" — along with the reason it was flagged.

records.name: Insytes Business Intelligence
records.tagline: Financial models, data insights and calculators
records.description: InsytesBI is a free online platform offering financial calculators, business tools, financial models, data analysis tools, and financial data. Explore tools for business finance, personal finance, healthcare, real estate, investing, and more. Access practical resources to analyze financial information, calculate key metrics, and make better-informed decisions without expensive software or subscriptions.

records.name: GoShow
records.tagline: A mobile app for finding concert friends and more.
records.description: GoShow is an app for people who want to strengthen their participation in the concert community. Our key features include: - see who's going to the same concert as you and send them messages - log the concerts that you've attended on your profile - join artist- and genre-related communities - add people to your friends and get notified when they go to the same concert as you. Most of our community is currently based in the Netherlands, but we are planning to expand in the future.

records.name: Lexleaf
records.tagline: PDF & EPUB reader: look up words without leaving the page
records.description: LexLeaf is a free, offline, open-source PDF and EPUB reader built for uninterrupted reading. Whenever you hit an unfamiliar word, just double-click it to see its meaning and examples right on the page—no switching tabs or losing your flow. You can also save words to your personal vocabulary list as you read. Built for students, non-native readers, and anyone tackling dense books.

records.name: Korea Audio Guide: Silgeo
records.tagline: Hear the stories behind the places you visit in Korea
records.description: Turn a stop at a Korean palace, temple, or historic site into a story you can listen to. Explore by region, look up a place, and choose from available guides in English, Korean, Japanese, or Simplified Chinese. Read along with transcripts or save individual recordings for offline listening. The guides include original recordings and transcripts from Korea Tourism Organization's Odii and are available without an account.

records.name: cubesolvex
records.tagline: Solve your Magic Cube online, step by step
records.description: Solve your Magic Cube online for free, no app required. Paint in your cube's colors or shuffle a random scramble, then follow an animated, move-by-move walkthrough at your own pace.

records.name: Lotto BaZi
records.tagline: Explore lottery numbers with BaZi and draw history
records.description: Discover a new way to explore lottery numbers. Lotto BaZi combines traditional BaZi and Five Elements inspiration with NZ and Australian lottery draw history. Generate number ideas, save combinations, and check past results. Free to use and available in five languages. For entertainment only: lottery results are random, and no method can guarantee a win.

records.name: Briefly
records.tagline: Turn a client's vague idea into a clear project brief
records.description: Clients rarely send real specs. Briefly is a short, guided questionnaire you send as a link. Your client answers in plain language: the problem, who will use it, the features they need and how much each one matters. "Not sure yet" is a fine answer. At the end they download a clean PDF brief and send it to you. Works in English, French and Arabic, with full right-to-left support. No server, no analytics: answers stay in the client's browser. Free and open source (MIT).

records.name: CellFlow Mobile Shop POS & ERP
records.tagline: Mobile Shop POS, Dual IMEI, Digital Khata, EMI & Repair Lab
records.description: All-in-one Android Mobile Shop POS & ERP app for Pakistani mobile retailers and repair labs with Dual IMEI inventory, seller CNIC logging, Digital Khata, monthly Qist (EMI), Repair Lab with live customer tracker, Bluetooth 58mm & 80mm thermal printing, QR Salesman Mode, 60-day Dead Stock Radar, 8-sheet Excel export, and 100% safe encrypted cloud sync.

records.name: MMTrader
records.tagline: A live trading market for your finance class in 30 seconds
records.description: MMTrader is a browser-based market microstructure simulator for university trading courses. The instructor picks a case, students join with a six-digit code and trade against each other in a live order book. No install, no student accounts. 65 ready-made cases across 7 tracks (equities, futures, options, commodities, fixed income, FX), a case builder, bots for small classes, and CSV data export for the debrief. Piloted with 85 students at NHH.

records.name: AI Figure Editor
records.tagline: Revise scientific figures with AI and keep every version
records.description: Upload a scientific schematic, mark what needs changing, and describe the revision. AI Figure Editor creates a new draft while retaining the source and earlier versions for comparison. Built for research workflows, pathways, graphical abstracts, and AI/ML architecture diagrams. Review labels and scientific relationships before using any generated result.

records.name: Sound Out: Read English
records.tagline: Learn to read English with phonics. Free and offline.
records.description: Sound Out teaches reading English from the first letter sound. A teacher-style voice models each sound, then you blend sounds into words and read short stories. 108 short lessons in 7 levels, a capybara guide for children and a calm track for grown-ups. Free, works offline, no ads, no account and no data collected.

records.name: StackCut
records.tagline: Track subscription costs and review them before renewal.
records.description: StackCut helps you manage subscriptions, track renewal dates, understand recurring costs, and spot unused or overlapping services before they renew. Keep everything organized in a private, encrypted workspace without connecting your bank account. https://stackcut.site/

records.name: KeepPlain
records.tagline: git blame for AI code, down to the agent session
records.description: KeepPlain keeps every session from your coding agents and puts it to work. Your agent finds what you already solved. Correct it twice and it suggests a rule for every agent. Near a limit, carry on in another agent. Point at a line and read the session that wrote it. Teams share one memory. Publish a session to its pull request, or turn someone else's into a skill. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Pi, Antigravity and 12 more. Secrets removed on your machine. Free for personal use.

records.name: Macaron
records.tagline: Turn customer messages into fixes ready for review
records.description: Macaron keeps customer support and fix work together. Collect messages from your app or website, turn conversations into bug reports, prepare a coding run, and review the changes before resolving the issue. Start free with one app or website. Coding runs use your configured machine and model access.

records.name: Neper
records.tagline: Global headlines and AI summaries in 9 languages
records.description: Read news from other countries in your language. Neper now automatically translates headlines and AI summaries into 9 languages. Choose your news country and reading language separately, see key people and organizations with sentiment cues, and browse a visual news gallery. Open original sources or ask ChatGPT about a story for more context.

records.name: RowPost
records.tagline: Mail merge from Google Sheets with a PDF for every person
records.description: Send a personalized email to every row of your Google Sheet from your own Gmail, each with its own PDF made from your Google Doc template: certificates, report cards, invoices, offer letters. Preview, test, schedule and track status in the sheet.

records.name: EchoPost
records.tagline: Telegram Marketing & Business Automation Suite
records.description: EchoPost is an advanced platform for automating work with Telegram: intelligent content parsing, rewriting using artificial intelligence, automatic content publication, parsing of channels, chats and audiences, attracting traffic and leads from Telegram.

records.name: Console Storage Planner
records.tagline: Fewest games to delete before your next big install
records.description: Plan what to delete before installing a big new console game. Compare PS5 and Xbox storage, protect your favorite games, and make room instantly. Private, free, and fan-made.

records.name: Proof Take
records.tagline: Check voiceovers against your script, locally on your Mac
records.description: Proof Take checks a recording or AI voiceover against its script on your Mac. Possible misreads, skipped and extra words are marked right in the script, linked to the waveform so you can jump and listen. Confirm or dismiss each hint, copy a fix list or save DAW marker files, then import the fixed take and re-check it. English and Chinese scripts. No upload, no account. Apple silicon, macOS 14+. 14-day free trial, then $29 once, lifetime updates.

records.name: BondaNews
records.tagline: Good news only. AI-curated headlines from around the world
records.description: BondaNews aggregates uplifting and positive news headlines from trusted sources worldwide, curated by AI to surface inspiring stories and filter out negativity. Your daily dose of good news.

records.name: CodeLearn Pro
records.tagline: CodeLearn Pro is a free programming learning app.
records.description: CodeLearn Pro is a free programming learning app designed for beginners. Learn five popular programming languages with short, focused lessons and hands-on practice. Every lesson teaches one concept. You read a short explanation, study a working code example, then try it yourself in the built-in editor. Tap "Run Code" and see the real output in seconds. More lessons are added regularly.

records.name: Ettukaali
records.tagline: A shy spider in a glass orb who keeps you company
records.description: Ettukaali is a free 3D web toy and focus timer by Viveka Mohan Das, made in Sydney. A redback spider weaves her web inside a glass orb while you study, work or rest. At first she is timid, then curious, then she trusts you. She has a focus timer and sixteen behaviours to find. Free, no sign-up.

records.name: Brick Art Creator
records.tagline: Turn any photo into a custom LEGO®-compatible brick mosaic
records.description: Turn a favorite photo into a mosaic you can build, one brick at a time. Choose a canvas, watch Brick Art Creator translate your image into LEGO®-compatible colors, then tweak any brick by hand. Get an exact parts list and a step-by-step booklet to take your design from screen to display. It’s free to create, edit, and download. Try it with a photo you love, then tell us what you made, we’d love your ideas and feedback.

records.name: Cephboy AI
records.tagline: One API. Powerful tools for developers.
records.description: Cephboy AI is a developer platform bringing API access, developer tools, and persistent memory capabilities into one workspace. Build and connect AI-powered workflows through a unified integration point. Explore Cephboy AI: https://cephboy.aillm.workers.dev Built for developers.

records.name: Wire Invoice
records.tagline: Commercial invoices for overseas clients
records.description: Bank-wire PDFs for companies and studios billing foreign clients. Invoices in the currency they wire. Dashboard totals in USD and your local currency.

records.name: Pinchery
records.tagline: Cook the recipes you keep saving
records.description: Pinchery turns TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and recipe website links into ingredients and steps, with credit to the creator. Change portions, get ingredient swaps for your country and cook from a clear recipe. Works in your browser on any phone or computer.

records.name: Webdesly Care
records.tagline: After-sales service and repairs for luxury maisons
records.description: Quiet after-sales desk for luxury maisons: service requests, repairs, and a Today board to triage or mark ready. Not a generic ticket queue, not a full CRM. Free demo desk and client portal, no signup.

records.name: PingCRM
records.tagline: Open-source personal CRM that syncs your DMs and email
records.description: PingCRM is an open-source personal networking CRM. It syncs Gmail, Telegram, Twitter/X, LinkedIn and WhatsApp into one timeline per contact, scores which relationships are going cold, spots life events like job changes, and drafts follow-ups with AI that it never sends on its own. New since the last launch: WhatsApp sync, an MCP server for Claude and Cursor, duplicate organization merging, and one-click deploys to Railway, Render, DigitalOcean and Fly.io.

records.name: 8D Creator: 8D Audio & Music
records.tagline: Move Spotify and Apple Music around your head, live
records.description: 8D Creator plays anything on your iPhone in 8D, live. Pick it as your audio output and Spotify, Apple Music, games and videos all go through it. Drag the sound around your head, up or down, while it plays. It runs the binaural engine from my plugin 3D Panner. You can also record your mix and save it to Files. Importing your own file is free; live listening from other apps is Pro, with a 7-day free trial. Needs iOS 27. Best on headphones.

records.name: NoEgress 2.0
records.tagline: Clean and analyze spreadsheets without uploading them
records.description: Open a CSV, Excel, JSON or Parquet file in your browser and work with it without uploading it anywhere. Clean messy data, find records that refer to the same customer, build pivots and charts, or ask a question in plain English. A model running on your own machine writes the SQL, and DuckDB runs it locally. The site's Content Security Policy blocks connections to any other domain, and a "0 sent" panel lists every network request. Free, with no account needed.

records.name: Pad Code AI: Code Editor & IDE
records.tagline: iPad & iPhone IDE: Run Python, C++ & JS offline with AI
records.description: Pad Code AI turns your iPad and iPhone into a complete coding studio: a native editor, 7 on-device runtimes (Python with debugger, C/C++, JS/TS, Ruby, PHP, Lua, SQLite), a terminal shell, Git, SSH/SFTP, and LaTeX and web previews. With Vibe Coding and the AI Agent (Ask, Plan, Edit, Auto), describe what you want and the AI plans, edits files with reviewable diffs and Undo, and runs code to verify its work—using private on-device Apple Intelligence, offline open models, or your own API keys.

records.name: Tamzar
records.tagline: One ERP for every branch, with rules you set yourself
records.description: Tamzar runs a company with several branches in one place: HR and payroll, attendance, stock, sales, purchases, finance and accounting. You draw your own approval paths, set policies per branch, and each person works in English, French or Arabic. There is a web dashboard, a Windows app for the sales counter and an Android app for employees.

records.name: CleanPDF Protect PDF
records.tagline: Password-protect PDFs in your browser. Nothing uploaded.
records.description: Add a password to any PDF with 128-bit AES encryption that opens in all common PDF readers. Encryption happens in your browser, so your file and your password are never uploaded. Free, with no sign-up, no watermark and no daily limits. Keep your password safe: a protected file can't be recovered without it.

records.name: Eucalyptus Essential Oil
records.tagline: Steam-distilled eucalyptus essential oil, cool and fresh
records.description: Rootsar Eucalyptus Essential Oil is steam-distilled from the leaves of the Eucalyptus globulus tree. It's a crisp, invigorating oil with a cool, fresh scent. 100% natural and 100% vegan. Use it in an evening diffuser or blend it with a carrier oil for a body oil after your shower.

records.name: Pro Academy Tools
records.tagline: 27 free GPA, grade and test score calculators for students
records.description: Pro Academy Tools is a free set of 27 calculators for students. Work out your semester or cumulative GPA, the score you need on a final, weighted grades, SAT, ACT, AP and IELTS score estimates, and percentage, CGPA or SGPA conversions. It covers grading systems in the US, India, Pakistan, the UK, Australia and Canada. Every tool shows its formula and a worked example and links to a plain-English guide. No sign-up, and built for mobile.

records.name: Bubble5
records.tagline: AI chat assistant that answers from your own information
records.description: Bubble5 is an AI chat assistant for small business websites. Upload your prices, hours and policies and it answers customers instantly, day and night, from your information only. If it doesn't know, it says so and emails you the question. Collects leads and booking requests, shows product pictures in the chat, and blocks card numbers. Free trial, no card needed, and we'll install it on your site for free.

records.name: Breezier
records.tagline: Turn a screen recording into a narrated product walkthrough
records.description: Breezier turns a screen recording into a product walkthrough people can follow. Record your screen or a Chrome tab, and Breezier finds the scenes, writes a script from what you said, narrates it with an AI voice and adds captions you can correct. With the Chrome companion, every click becomes an automatic zoom. Add your brand, export landscape, vertical and square versions, or share a link for review. Made for small SaaS teams keeping demos and help videos current.

records.name: Photoproduct.io
records.tagline: Let Claude and ChatGPT make your images, video and audio
records.description: Ask your AI agent for a product shot, a video, a voiceover or a soundtrack, and the finished file appears right in the conversation. Photoproduct.io is one remote MCP server with 1,700+ models, including Nano Banana, Kling, Veo, Seedance and FLUX. Your agent picks the model and writes the prompt. Works in Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other MCP apps. Google sign-in, no API keys, a daily limit for each app. No subscription; credits never expire.

records.name: Make Custom QR Code
records.tagline: Custom QR codes that never expire. No subscription, ever.
records.description: Design a QR code for a website, PDF, menu, WiFi, vCard, WhatsApp and 10 more types, with colors, patterns, logos and frames, and a live phone preview that checks it still scans. Static codes are free forever with no watermark. Need to edit a code after printing? Pay $1 once per code, or $99 once for unlimited. No trials, no auto-renewals, and printed codes are never switched off for not paying.

records.name: Knowhere Postgres
records.tagline: Native PostgreSQL IDE for Mac, with notebooks that remember
records.description: Knowhere is a native Mac workspace for PostgreSQL. Write SQL, edit data with staged, reviewable changes, explore schema diagrams, and read query plans. New in 1.1: notebooks that remember. Re-run an investigation and see what changed per cell: rows, contents, timing, even the query plan. Plus Activity & Locks to find what's blocking what. Direct connections, no account, no cloud relay. One-time purchase, no subscription.

records.name: Price Right
records.tagline: Shared grocery list comparing live unit prices. Zero ads.
records.description: Price Right is a free, ad-free shared grocery list for iOS and Android that compares real per-unit prices ($/oz, €/kg, Kč/l) across nearby supermarkets and online stores so you stop guessing whether the bulk pack or another store is cheaper. Snap shelf tags or receipts with your camera, group items by store aisle, and share live checklists via a web link with no app install required. Built for 15 countries and 10 languages, plus a free web unit-price calculator.

records.name: WellPriced
records.tagline: Pricing audit for Jobber cleaning and lawn care companies
records.description: WellPriced ranks every recurring customer of a cleaning or lawn care company by revenue per labor hour, drive time included. Export four reports from Jobber (about 10 minutes) and the free short audit shows how much more a year your undercharged customers would bring in at your typical rate. The paid full report adds a recommended new price for each one, with no single increase above 10%. Free calculators for bids and drive costs, no sign-up.

records.name: GoMeter
records.tagline: See your speed, acceleration and climb on every adventure
records.description: More than a speed gauge. GoMeter shows your speed by GPS with a live speed graph and live acceleration and braking as you move. Afterwards you get the whole trip second by second: speed, acceleration and elevation profiles, max speed, climb and personal bests. That makes it fit any adventure, from a boat ride or a zipline to a bike trail, a ski run or a train. Free, with no account and no ads, and your trips stay on your phone. For iPhone and Android.

records.name: BeChosenBy
records.tagline: See if ChatGPT recommends your business, and how to fix it
records.description: BeChosenBy asks ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity 10 questions your buyers ask in your category. The report shows how often each engine names you, which businesses it names instead, which websites it cites, and five fixes ranked by impact. The Fix Pack writes those fixes for you: homepage lines, a comparison page, an FAQ with structured data and outreach emails. Free preview with one real buyer question; one-time reports from $19, no subscription.

records.name: zones.fyi
records.tagline: A time zone converter that works well on phones
records.description: For anyone who checks other cities' times on their phone. Add your cities, drag one bar to change the time, and every city updates. Pick a 30 min, 1 hr or 2 hr slot and it flags anyone who'd be asleep or outside work hours, then copy all the times into a message. No signup, no ads.

records.name: MjPetz
records.tagline: Work, play and share with all your AI agents in one place
records.description: MjPetz puts a pet on your desktop for each AI agent you use: Claude Code, Codex, Grok (your subscription or API key), Hermes and more, all in one chat. Agents answer each other and wait for your OK before they act. No AI subscription? MjPetz Mini is built in: a small brain that answers on your own computer, offline, with no account. While they work, play Block Brawl Chess, floating right on your desktop on Windows. Free for Windows, Mac and Linux, with a one-time Pro.

records.name: Snap Scanner
records.tagline: Free PDF Toolkit: Convert, Sign, Merge, Build & More
records.description: Snap Scanner is a 100% free, browser-based toolkit — no sign-up, no uploads, files never leave your device. Features: • Scan & convert to PDF • JPG, PNG & image conversions • Merge, split & compress PDFs • Fill, sign, annotate, compare & lock/unlock PDFs • Resume builder • ID card, business card & certificate maker • Invoice maker • QR code generator Free forever. Works on desktop & Android.

records.name: IngrediScan AI
records.tagline: Scan food labels to spot allergens, additives & E-numbers
records.description: IngrediScan AI decodes food, beverage, and cosmetic labels in seconds using advanced AI. Simply snap a photo of any ingredient list to instantly uncover hidden additives, E-numbers, and potential health risks. Tailor your scan results to your personal health and dietary needs—including vegan, diabetic, pregnancy-safe, and common allergens. Keep your family's pantry safe with instant health scores, clarity checks, and a complete additive dictionary.

records.name: Rankhog
records.tagline: Get customers from Reddit on autopilot
records.description: Rankhog finds people on Reddit asking for what you sell. It reads each subreddit's rules, writes a reply that helps, and posts it from your own account at a human pace. Say yes to each reply, or turn on autopilot. No Reddit account? Rankhog warms up a new one, and you own it. Run it from the app, or from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and any MCP client. 7 days free.

records.name: Zapyso
records.tagline: Free meeting notes and dictation that stay on your Mac
records.description: Zapyso records your calls on the Mac itself, with no bot joining, and writes a transcript and a summary with decisions and next steps. It notices calls in Zoom, Teams, Google Meet, Slack and more. Hold the right ⌘ key to dictate into any app. Speech recognition and summaries run on-device, so recordings and notes never leave your Mac. No account. Free, on Mac and iPhone. Needs Apple silicon and macOS 15.

records.name: Fosbury
records.tagline: The AI customer engineer
records.description: Fosbury is an AI customer engineer. It joins live calls, answers questions out loud, and runs your product on a demo account, at any hour, in any language. One engineer covers the whole journey: it gives every prospect a live demo, qualifies the lead, and hands hot deals to sales, then helps the same customer through onboarding and support. Every call is replayed and turned into context for your team and a ranked list of product requests. Zero installs, and it looks like your brand.

records.name: Verge: Corner Controls
records.tagline: Swipe a screen corner to set brightness, volume and more
records.description: Verge turns the four corners of your Android screen into controls. Swipe in at a corner and a ruler tape wraps around the rounded edge of your display. Slide to set brightness (with extra dim below 0%), volume, launch apps or use quick tools like the flashlight and Do Not Disturb. Free, no ads, no account, no internet permission and no Accessibility Service. The Back gesture stays free, and it speaks 10 languages.

records.name: Robnur
records.tagline: Free QR menu that rings your phone on every order
records.description: Robnur turns every table into an order point. Guests scan the QR, browse your menu and order from their own phone, no app to install. Your phone rings with each order, even when locked. Free, in Bangla and English, built for restaurants in Bangladesh.

records.name: The Browser AI
records.tagline: Private media tools that run entirely in your browser
records.description: The Browser AI is a free suite of 20 browser-based media tools. Compress videos for email, chat and the web, convert common image and video formats, trim clips, extract audio, remove backgrounds, upscale images and more — without uploading your files. Processing happens on your device; some tools download WebAssembly runtimes or open AI models on first use. No account or install required.

records.name: ShareSetu
records.tagline: Paper trade Nifty options on live NSE data, free
records.description: Practise Nifty, Bank Nifty and Sensex options with ₹50,000 of virtual money on real NSE market data. Real brokerage, taxes and margin, no broker account needed. Also free: a live option chain with PCR and max pain, GIFT Nifty with global cues, NSE stock pages, a market heatmap, an IPO GMP tracker, mutual fund NAVs and SIP/SWP calculators. For learning only, not investment advice.

records.name: COKIQ
records.tagline: Cookie consent for Indian websites, with a DPDP Act profile
records.description: COKIQ is cookie consent for Indian websites. It scans every cookie, tag and pixel your pages load, holds trackers until a visitor chooses, and keeps dated consent records you can export. India DPDP Act banner profile, prices in INR (paid plans from ₹799/month) and a free plan for one site, no card. Passes choices to Google Consent Mode v2. EU/UK and US profiles too. Also: WordPress plugin, Chrome extension, GTM template, iOS/Android app and a public API.

records.name: LidAwake
records.tagline: Close your MacBook. Your Mac keeps working
records.description: Close the lid and your Mac keeps working: builds, renders, downloads or an AI agent keep running, no external display needed. Stops on overheating or low battery, can run only while charging, and gives normal sleep back when the job is done. LidAwake Pro adds Movie on a TV (close the lid, the movie keeps playing), waits for downloads and video exports to finish, and In a Bag mode with stricter safeguards for a closed Mac in your bag.

records.name: ChatSuite
records.tagline: AI Buddy + omnichannel inbox, agents & flows
records.description: ChatSuite is the all-in-one customer communication OS: AI Buddy (in-app copilot that connects channels, runs Auto DM, publishes, opens any workspace page), plus a shared inbox across WhatsApp Cloud API, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, YouTube, Email & Website Chat — with AI Agents, Flow Builder, Campaigns, CRM, commerce, analytics, Meta Ads, and API/webhooks. Plans from $9.57/mo, 0% Meta message markup.

records.name: Do It For Them Wallpaper Maker
records.tagline: Photo wallpapers for the people you do it for
records.description: Turn your favorite photos into a taped collage for your phone, desktop, video calls, or social banners. Choose a layout, add your own words, and arrange the photos in your browser. Watermarked downloads are free. $5 buys five watermark-free exports, including ZIPs and 300 DPI print PDFs up to 4 × 6 feet.

records.name: ExpenseCatcher
records.tagline: Receipts behind a login, renamed and filed in one click
records.description: Some invoices never reach your inbox: they sit behind a login, in Cursor, Meta ads or a Stripe portal. Download them as usual, under any name, into any folder. Our Chrome extension spots each download, and one click sends it to ExpenseCatcher: it reads the vendor, date, total and tax, renames the file, saves it to Drive, logs it to your Sheet or sends it to your accountant. No renaming, no sorting, no retyping numbers. Emailed receipts? Just forward them.

records.name: OddForge ContractorOS PRO
records.tagline: Builder's Estimating, Quoting & Job Profit System
records.description: Professional estimating and quoting software for builders and contractors. Calculate materials, labour and profit, manage multiple projects, track variations...

records.name: YTAmp Retro
records.tagline: Winamp-style YouTube player with 200% volume, EQ & visuals
records.description: YTAmp Retro turns YouTube and YouTube Music into a Winamp-inspired listening experience. This free Chrome extension adds a 200% volume booster, bass boost, dynamic leveling, a 10-band equalizer with custom presets, 54 audio-reactive visualizers (Canvas + WebGL), 15 retro skins, customizable themes and a movable mini player. Browse visual effects, save favorites and go immersive. Audio processing happens locally after your consent. No account, subscription or tracking. Old school. New power.

records.name: CitedEvidence for ChatGPT & Claude
records.tagline: Real papers and checked references inside your AI chat
records.description: Connect CitedEvidence to ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code or Codex with your CitedEvidence sign-in (no API key). Your assistant can then search 250 million real papers, check a reference list for wrong DOIs or years, format citations in APA, MLA, Chicago, IEEE and more with BibTeX, save papers to your Library, and start Deep Research or a manuscript review, with interactive results in the chat.

records.name: Toasttrail
records.tagline: AI Video Editor: Turn Clips into Reels & Vlogs
records.description: Toasttrail is an AI video editor: upload your clips, describe the video in plain words, and it cuts, captions and adds music and colour. Free to start.

records.name: Physicly
records.tagline: See what your training changes.
records.description: The mirror lies and the scale can’t tell muscle from fat. Physicly shows what your training actually changes. Take one 10-second photo a day: the AI X-Ray scores 12 muscle groups, estimates body fat and shows what changed since day one. A ghost overlay keeps every shot in the same spot and light. AI Predict projects your own body 6 months out, and AI Coach builds workouts around the muscles that lag. Workout logging and Apple Health trends included. Free to start on iPhone.

records.name: Minuttio
records.tagline: Time Tracking and Profitability for SMEs
records.description: **Minuttio: Time Tracking and Profitability for SMEs** Wait a Minuttio. Minuttio brings project management, task management, time tracking and expense tracking into one application. Plan client projects, track billable and non-billable work, monitor costs and understand which projects are actually profitable. Built for freelancers, consultants, agencies and small businesses that want better visibility into their work and profitability. Start free at minuttio.com.

records.name: Homeport
records.tagline: The home for every local project you run
records.description: Start, stop, watch and share all your dev servers (Laravel, Node, Python, Rails, Go, Rust, Docker, static sites and more) from one page in your browser. Homeport detects how to run each project, gives it a named URL like blog.localhost, previews it on your phone by QR, shares it on a password-protected public link, and explains crashes in plain words with one-click fixes. Free, open source (MIT), for macOS, Windows and Linux. No account, no cloud.

records.name: MixMusic
records.tagline: Spotify and YouTube Music in one free, open-source player
records.description: MixMusic is a free, open-source alternative to the official Spotify and YouTube Music desktop apps. One search, one queue and one library across both services, with mixed playlists, synced lyrics, an equalizer, themes and plugins. YouTube Music plays with no account, and Spotify tracks can play through YouTube Music without Premium. A native app for Windows, macOS and Linux that draws on the GPU, with no browser inside.

records.name: Plugg Africa
records.tagline: Virtual numbers for WhatsApp and 150+ apps, across Africa
records.description: Plugg gives you a virtual phone number to receive SMS codes for WhatsApp, Telegram, Google, TikTok and 150+ other apps. Pick a country and service, pay in your own currency, and the code shows up on the page. No code? Your money goes back to your wallet. Plugg also has free tools for every African country: a scam number checker that shows reports on a number before you reply, and a crypto wallet tracker that shows BTC, ETH and USDT balances in your local currency. Built solo in Enugu, Nigeria.

records.name: ENAT
records.tagline: Digital Loyalty Program & Event Ticketing Platform
records.description: Run a Digital loyalty program for your small cafe and shop! Issue Digital Wallet that reflect your business identity, the platform learns the habits of your customers to help you generate more revenue from the same client. Run Event tickets for your events, issue digital Wallet tickets, manage attendee lists, and validate QR tickets at the door with ENAT for Events. Shop owners and Organizers can request an invitation.

records.name: ASPMM
records.tagline: Turn manhwa & manga chapters into narrated recap videos
records.description: Upload the manhwa or manga chapters you have the rights to use. ASPMM reads every panel, writes the story script, records the voice-over and renders a finished recap video, from 5 minutes up to 12 hours. Add thumbnails, titles, descriptions and Shorts with modern captions, in 38 languages. You see the exact token price before anything renders. Built for recap channel creators who want to publish more without days of editing.

records.name: Hawky
records.tagline: AI Agents purpose-built to win paid media
records.description: Hawky is an agentic performance marketing platform. Its Performance Agent runs paid media on Meta, Google, TikTok and LinkedIn against your KPI, the Creative Agent ships on-brand ads built from your winners, and the AdOps Agent handles bulk launches and test-to-scale rules. Every move is logged and reversible, and a shared memory makes each result improve the next decision. 100+ brands and agencies use it, including Amazon, Puma and Unilever.

records.name: Postal Code Finder
records.tagline: Postal codes, zip codes and postcodes worldwide
records.description: Postal Code Finder is a free reference for postal codes worldwide: zip codes in the US, postcodes in the UK and Australia, PIN codes in India and postal codes in 113 countries and territories, over 2 million in all. Each place has its codes, a map and an example address in the country's format. Free tools: codes within a radius, distance between codes, what council am I in (UK), how to address an envelope and the code formats of 186 countries. No sign-up; installable as an app.

records.name: Showthrough - recorder you own
records.tagline: Loom alternative: pay once, record unlimited videos
records.description: Press one button and Showthrough handles the rest. It records your screen, camera and voice from any Chrome tab, uploads while you talk, and copies the share link the moment you stop. No limit on how many videos you record or how long they run. Viewers watch in any browser without an account, and can comment at the exact moment. Videos are stored in your own Cloudflare account, which we set up for you in one click. One payment, no subscription. Team members are coming soon at no extra cost.

records.name: Peppermint Essential Oil
records.tagline: Steam-distilled peppermint oil, nothing added
records.description: Rootsar Peppermint Essential Oil is steam-distilled from Mentha piperita leaves. It has a cool, crisp mint scent and is bottled at full strength, with nothing added and no fake scent.

records.name: Size
records.tagline: A trading survival game on live market prices
records.description: Size turns live market prices into competitive cash games. Choose your entry amount, trade through elimination stages, and compete for a cash payout. Try the demo or Practice before entering a cash game. Entry and payout terms apply.

records.name: 30yr-uptime
records.tagline: Claude Code mod for taking care of your body
records.description: A Claude Code mod that turns waiting on Claude into movement breaks. Every 45 min, when a turn runs past 15s, a pixel character acts out one of 16 moves for your neck, back, hips, legs, wrists, eyes or lungs. Done, In 5 min or Skip. Local, zero tokens.

records.name: EmailTimer.app
records.tagline: Countdown timers that are right when the email opens
records.description: EmailTimer.app makes email countdown timers and personalized images that are drawn the second each subscriber opens. Design in the editor, copy the snippet for Klaviyo, Mailchimp, HubSpot and 18 more, send. Works in Gmail, Outlook and Apple Mail. Free for 5,000 opens.

records.name: MedicDay
records.tagline: AI-powered Clinic & Pharmacy Management, Simplified
records.description: MedicDay, from YRO Systems Private Limited, is streamlined, AI-powered clinic and pharmacy management for independent healthcare providers. MocDoc is YRO Systems’ comprehensive healthcare management ecosystem for clinics, hospitals and laboratories. MedicDay has a distinct focus: helping independent providers manage AI-assisted voice consultations, structured medical casesheets, digital prescriptions, patients, clinic billing and pharmacy workflows in one practical solution.

records.name: DualZen
records.tagline: Record Portrait and Landscape Video at the Same Time
records.description: DualZen is a phone camera that records 9:16 portrait and 16:9 landscape video or photos from one take, with a built-in teleprompter, pro controls, and front + back camera capture, for iPhone and Android.

records.name: Glowmy
records.tagline: Live desktop effects for Windows: Matrix, CRT, 3D & music
records.description: Glowmy draws live effects over your whole Windows desktop, and everything stays clickable. Pick a ready look (Matrix rain in empty space, CRT and VHS screens, a 3D floating desktop, music visualizers) or build your own in the Mixer: stack a colour grade, glow, film look, atmosphere, music effect, window effects, style, motion and a clock, in your own colours. Free for Windows 10 and 11; Pro unlocks everything for a one-time price.

records.name: EraseMark
records.tagline: Free Browser-Based Watermark Remover
records.description: Free, private, browser-based watermark removers for Google Gemini images and Veo videos. EraseMark uses mathematical reverse alpha unblending to restore pixel perfection without AI hallucinations or quality loss. 100% client-side privacy: zero files are ever uploaded or stored on servers. No signup, no subscriptions, completely free.

records.name: Mixer – SoundRelay
records.tagline: Every Mac app and browser tab gets its own volume
records.description: Mixer puts a slider and a mute for every app, every browser tab and your speakers in the Mac menu bar and on your Stream Deck. Turn the call up and the music down without touching anything else. It uses the audio taps in macOS 14.4 and later: no driver, no restart, and apps left at 100 % are not touched. A free extension for Chrome, Edge, Brave, Arc, Vivaldi, Opera and Helium installs from inside the app. 7 days free, then €10 once.

records.name: Spell Kingdom
records.tagline: Spelling and Maths Games for Kids, Years 1–6
records.description: Spell Kingdom turns screen time into spelling and maths practice for kids aged 6–12 (Years 1–6). Kids play games and explore a 3D open world, while a parent page shows the words they find tricky so you know what to practise. No ads, no chat. Free to start, with paid options.

records.name: RasedLink
records.tagline: Know your site is down before your customers do
records.description: RasedLink monitors your websites and services 24/7 and alerts you on WhatsApp, email, or webhook the moment something goes down - before your customers notice. Uptime stats, response time, outage history, SSL & SEO checks. First month free.

records.name: vTTS: Offline Text to Speech
records.tagline: Read EPUB & PDF aloud offline in 17 languages or your voice
records.description: Make time for the books you love, even when your eyes need a break. vTTS reads EPUB, PDF (with on-device OCR), DOCX and text aloud 100% offline on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Android with built-in neural voices in 17 languages. Record 20 seconds in the Voice Studio to listen in a voice made from yours—processed locally and deleted right after creation. Includes sentence highlighting, on-device book translation, sleep timer, listening streaks, and M4B/MP3 audiobook export.

records.name: Vonex Design
records.tagline: Finished website templates your AI agent makes yours
records.description: Finished website templates for restaurants, clinics, therapists, real estate and studios. Each comes as a Framer template and as hand-written Astro + Tailwind code, with the same Agent Kit: design rules and skills that let Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or the Framer Agent swap in your content and help you publish. The site is built; your AI makes it yours.

records.name: GhostTunnel
records.tagline: Peer-to-peer ephemeral snaps and chat, with zero servers
records.description: GhostTunnel lets two people share disappearing photos and short messages directly between their browsers. There is no database, no signaling server, and no account signup. Both sides pair using a shared passkey and encrypted handshake tokens, verify a 6-digit Safety Number, and communicate in volatile RAM over WebRTC and libsodium. Photos are stripped of EXIF data, viewed only while holding the screen, and wiped from memory the moment you let go.

records.name: Close Testers
records.tagline: Get 12 testers for your 14-day Google Play closed test
records.description: Close Testers helps Android developers meet Google Play's 12 testers for 14 days closed testing requirement. Join other developers' test groups, complete short daily tasks with automatic install & usage verification, earn publishing credits, and get real testers for your own app. Send bug reports and screenshots directly to developer inboxes. Available in 12 languages with optional Premium plans.

records.name: Spindl
records.tagline: Scan a record, know its pressing and what it's worth
records.description: Scan a barcode or snap the sleeve of any vinyl, CD or cassette and Spindl fills in the artist, year, label, pressing and what it's worth. Then it keeps you digging: a daily feed about your records, a Wishlist and artist hunts, shelves, Spin It to pick tonight's record, and record stores near you. Free for your first 50 records. Pro is $39.99 a year or $3.99 a month, for up to 5,000 records and 300 AI cover scans a year.

records.name: CHERMO
records.tagline: Turn your photos and inside jokes into a page you can gift
records.description: Choose a template, send your photos and a personal message, and CHERMO prepares a memory page you can share by link. Designed for birthdays, anniversaries and friendships in India. Memory pages are a one-time purchase. The free Memory Studio lets you make and download a Polaroid, photo strip or collage.

records.name: Studio for Replicate
records.tagline: Run 100+ AI models from Replicate in one free desktop app
records.description: Free desktop app (Mac, Windows, Linux) for 100+ AI models on Replicate: images, video, talking avatars with your cloned voice, 3D and audio. No code, prices shown upfront, results saved locally. Bring your own Replicate API key and pay only per use.

records.name: Florank
records.tagline: See if ChatGPT recommends your site and what to fix
records.description: Your customers now ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI which company to choose. Florank shows whether they recommend your site, which competitors they name instead and which sources they cite. Then it tells you what to fix: an SEO and AI-readiness audit with step-by-step instructions, keyword tracking, a weekly 3-action plan, article drafts and backlinks. For small businesses, SaaS and SEO agencies. English and Ukrainian. Free site check on florank.ai.

records.name: ILoveNotch
records.tagline: A free, open-source notch app for Mac, now in ten themes
records.description: ILoveNotch turns your MacBook's notch into a tray for music, files, calendar, Reminders, notes, clipboard and timers. 2.0 adds ten themes that restyle every tab and a teleprompter that follows your voice. Free and MIT on GitHub; $1.99 on the Mac App Store.

records.name: AtlanteanBlue
records.tagline: Answers to Your Life Questions
records.description: AtlanteanBlue answers your personal life questions by combining four traditions in one reading: astrology (your birth chart), numerology, tarot and the I Ching. Enter your birth date, time and city, ask about love, career or a big decision, and get a clear, personalized answer in seconds. Your first three questions are free, no credit card. Unlimited access is $7/year. Your data is deleted after seven days. For entertainment purposes only.

records.name: Kiyo Planner
records.tagline: A planner for women. Your cycle, right on your calendar.
records.description: Most planners help you get more done. Kiyo is a planner for women that helps you plan with yourself in mind: events, to-dos, and habits on one calendar, with your cycle phases in the background, so you can decide how much to take on.

records.name: ViralScope
records.tagline: Did your video beat your own channel? Now you can tell
records.description: ViralScope turns YouTube data into decisions. OutlierX compares a video against the median of its own channel, VPH shows how fast it travels, Viral Search finds outliers in your niche and Trend Radar shows what is moving this week. It runs on the web, as a Chrome and Edge extension that shows both metrics on top of YouTube, and inside Claude through MCP. Free plan with 30 searches a month; Plus is 9 €/month. It does not predict CTR: it gives you signals to decide with.

records.name: MediaPostAI
records.tagline: AI Social Media Post Generator - free captions & hashtags
records.description: MediaPostAI is an AI social media post generator for every kind of business - from brands and business owners to digital agencies and marketing companies managing many clients. Set up each brand once, and AI creates post ideas, scroll-stopping captions, smart hashtags and on-brand designs. Polish any design in the built-in Canva-like editor, plan posts on your calendar, and connected Facebook Pages publish automatically at the time you choose. Free plan, no credit card needed.

records.name: Texter Mess
records.tagline: A canvas for thinking with LLMs
records.description: Texter Mess is a canvas for thinking with LLMs. Chats are conversation trees now instead of one linear thread. You can branch every chat in any direction, and everything you connect to a prompt becomes part of its context (even images). You can work on a canvas together with others in real time but if you like working in peace, your changes still sync as soon as you are back. Texter Mess is completely free when using your own Anthropic or OpenAI key.

records.name: Vaiyah
records.tagline: AI Studio for images, video & audio, with tree planting
records.description: Generate images, video and audio with your choice of AI models. Edit your work with a free video editor and image tools, and build your brand with logos and style guides. No subscription. Pay as you go. Sign up for 20 free Nano Banana images and one free Veo video every day for a limited time. Add an optional contribution to help fund tree planting through Ecologi.

records.name: LoRA AI
records.tagline: Train custom LoRA models. Create AI images and videos.
records.description: Train custom LoRA models for characters, products and styles, then generate AI images and videos in your browser. Prepare datasets, edit captions and choose compatible image or video models. Training and generation use credits, with costs shown before submission.

records.name: Winaruz
records.tagline: All your daily tools in one private window
records.description: Tasks, notes, a focus timer, screenshots, a password manager and 30+ more tools in one window or the side panel. No account, no analytics: your data stays on your device. Install only the tools you need and arrange Home as a grid of widgets.

records.name: Comex Trade Workspace
records.tagline: Blind Teasers & Commission Desk for Commodity Brokers
records.description: COMEX is a trade workspace for independent commodity brokers and mandates. Create blind teasers using SEL/BUY/MAN codes, organize counterparties and documents, track deal stages from LOI to payment, and manage trial vs. 12-month commission structures. Built to keep commodity deal workflows organized in one place. Start with a FREE 3-day trial.

records.name: After Goodnight
records.tagline: A first-love visual novel: choose Memory or What if
records.description: After Goodnight is a free, 30-minute romance visual novel about first love and the years after it. At each turning point, choose Memory (what happened) or What if (what you wish you had said). Your choices lead to three endings. Play in your browser on phone, tablet, or computer, with no download, account, or ads. Progress saves locally. An original story with AI-generated artwork.

records.name: Tiny Desk AI video studio
records.tagline: Turn portraits into AI desk-concert videos
records.description: Create a short, vertical desk-concert video from one to five portraits. Pick the lead performer, generate a clip with a soundtrack, then preview and download the MP4 for Reels or TikTok. Watch sample clips for free. Video generation uses prepaid credits, starting at $14.90 for one video.

records.name: MindPal MCP
records.tagline: ChatGPT & Claude build AI tools your clients use
records.description: Connect MindPal MCP to ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code or Cursor and ask in plain words: your assistant builds AI agents and workflows from your knowledge, publishes them as AI tools your clients, team and audience use by link, reads what they asked, and fixes the gaps. Free on every MindPal plan.

records.name: Sales Desk
records.tagline: Answer every lead in seconds and call back the ready ones
records.description: Sales Desk answers every enquiry on your site in seconds and gets it to your team the same day, so more of the leads you pay for turn into deals. An AI assistant trained on your own site replies; anything it is not sure about goes to a person. Your team only calls back people who are ready, and each one arrives with what they asked and a suggested time. It works with your forms, chat and CRM through one line of code, so nothing on your site changes. No new hires, no new ad spend.

records.name: Booth
records.tagline: Booth, your business's AI front desk
records.description: Give Booth your website, documents or FAQs. It answers your customers' questions around the clock, at its own link and QR code, or on your website. Free to set up and try.

records.name: AdReach EU
records.tagline: How often your competitor's Google ads were shown in Europe
records.description: Under the EU Digital Services Act, Google publishes an impression range for every ad shown in Europe, one ad at a time. AdReach EU adds them up for every advertiser in Google's EU ad repository. Search a brand to see its ads, its longest-running ad, the ads it launched in the last 30 days, and the minimum number of times its ads were shown. Free to use.

records.name: Nuit Blanche
records.tagline: Let your agents run with the lid closed.
records.description: Keeps your MacBook running with the lid shut, on battery, no monitor. Press ⌃⌥⌘L and your Claude Code or Codex agents keep working. They can switch it off when done. A timer, a 20% battery floor and a heat cut-off cover the rest. 5 nights free.

records.name: Milo for ChatGPT
records.tagline: Turn conversations into plans, birthdays, and shared agendas
records.description: Milo is your friendly agenda, now inside ChatGPT. Instead of manually entering every detail, simply ask ChatGPT to help organize a trip, keep track of birthdays, or plan something with friends and family. Milo brings those plans into an organized agenda you can return to and share. Built by the small team at Tiger Mind Labs, we're exploring a more natural way to turn conversations into real-life plans.

records.name: QueryPress
records.tagline: Live Search Plugin for WordPress with Filters
records.description: QueryPress is a free live search plugin for WordPress. Create records for anything (businesses, products, properties, events), add your own fields like price, city or phone, and visitors get instant results as they type, with dropdown filters and categories. It uses its own index tables, so it stays fast, and it's built with SEO in mind. No coding needed. Want more? QueryPress Pro adds colors, dark mode, sorting, CSV import and featured records.

records.name: Kreators Clan
records.tagline: Creators send it. Brands ask for it.
records.description: Brands ask for "insights", creators send 12 screenshots, and nobody trusts the numbers. Kreators Clan fixes this with the Clan Card: a media kit in one link, read straight from Instagram. Best posts, followers, reach per post, strengths and audience cities, with nothing editable by hand. Creators choose what it shows, see how often it's opened and can switch it off. Free for nano and micro creators, with a weekly Insights coach and paid brand jobs built in.

records.name: Certisent
records.tagline: Send USPS Certified Mail online, tracked at every step
records.description: Certisent mails your letter as USPS Certified Mail with an electronic return receipt, so you skip the post office. Upload your own PDF or fill in a template, check the exact printed letter and price, and we print it and hand it to USPS. You get an email at every step, a tracking page with no account needed, and an evidence pack PDF with the tracking history, a copy of your letter and the delivery record. Your card is charged only after your letter passes our check.

records.name: AI Expat Jobs
records.tagline: AI jobs at companies that can sponsor your visa
records.description: Find AI, ML and data jobs in the UK, the Netherlands and Germany at companies that can actually sponsor your visa. Every UK and Dutch employer is matched to the official sponsor register (Home Office and IND), and every ad is read for pay, sponsorship, relocation and language. Ads that say "we can't sponsor" are left out. Refreshed daily from employers' own job boards. Free, no login, plus a weekly email of new roles.

records.name: Unfurl
records.tagline: Daily Flag Quiz for iPhone
records.description: Guess five flags a day, the same five for everyone. Each correct answer adds a flag to your album and colors its country on your globe. Along the way, you’ll learn what the flags mean and how to tell lookalikes apart. The daily quiz is free, and a one-time Plus purchase unlocks extra practice.

records.name: Pocket Poker
records.tagline: Free Hold'em against bots, right in your Mac's menu bar
records.description: Pocket Poker is a free, native menu bar app for play-money No-Limit Hold'em against twelve bots, each with its own personality. No ads, no accounts. The table pauses when you click away, and a learning mode helps you improve. For macOS 26 on Apple Silicon.

records.name: दस्तावेज़ सहायक
records.tagline: हर काग़ज़, आसान हिंदी में
records.description: A free Hindi document helper. Paste or upload any document (letter, contract, notice) and get a simple Hindi explanation, summary, answers from the document, plus dates, money and deadlines extracted. Includes Manus-style tasks (presentation outline, report, research summary, letter/application), a government-scheme checker, and Feed, Ideas, Tasks and Connectors (Telegram connects for real; Gmail/Calendar/Drive marked coming soon). No sign-up needed; data stays in your browser.

records.name: sparda
records.tagline: Turn app behavior into a verifiable graph for devs & AI
records.description: AI writes. SPARDA proves. A deterministic, offline gate that catches when an AI edit removes a guard, exposes a route, or breaks an invariant — no API key, right in the agent edit loop. - zakariagh...

records.name: QR Code Lab
records.tagline: Branded QR codes, editable links and scan analytics
records.description: QR Code Lab is a web platform for creating and managing branded QR codes. Create static codes and editable dynamic codes, customize designs with logos, colors and frames, export codes for print or digital use, and review scan activity in a dashboard. The site also provides QR destination inspection tools and an authenticated API for automated QR generation. A free plan is available alongside paid plans with higher usage limits.

records.name: Creator Starter Bundle
records.tagline: Four creator packs in one bundle: hooks, scripts & prompts
records.description: Four packs, one workflow: open with a hook, script it, schedule it, and let structured prompts do the repetitive drafting. Inside: 100 Fill-In Hooks for TikTok, Reels & Shorts; 50 Script Templates for short videos; a 30-Day Content Calendar; and 100 AI Prompts Built for Creator Work. Bought separately: $32. Together: $19. Format: PDF downloads, instant delivery.

records.name: 奇客苹果手机解锁
records.tagline: 一键解除 iPhone/iPad 锁屏、Apple ID 与屏幕使用时间密码
records.description: 忘记 iPhone 锁屏密码、多次输错密码导致设备停用，接手二手设备却被 Apple ID 绑定，或是弄丢屏幕使用时间管控密码，是很多苹果用户都会遇到的麻烦。线下维修店收费高昂，等待周期漫长，iTunes 刷机操作复杂，普通用户很难独立上手。奇客 iPhone 解锁是一款面向个人用户的电脑端 iOS 解锁工具，一站式解决 iPhone、iPad、iPod Touch 各类锁定难题，不用专业技术，跟着软件指引就能自主操作。 它支持移除多种 iOS 锁类型，覆盖 4 位、6 位数字密码，自定义混合密码，同时支持清除 Face ID 面容锁、Touch ID 指纹锁，还可以解除陌生 Apple ID 绑定，清除屏幕使用时间密码，覆盖绝大多数日常锁定场景。软件适配主流 iPhone 与 iPad 机型，兼容多个 iOS 版本，Windows 和 Mac 双端都可以运行。操作流程简单直观，只需用数据线把设备连接电脑，软件自动识别机型，引导设备进入对应模式，下载匹配固件后一键启动解锁，避开繁琐的命令行和复杂刷机流程。

records.name: HopFix
records.tagline: remote support in the browser, with AI that reads the screen
records.description: HopFix is remote support for IT teams. Your customer shares their screen from a link, with nothing to install. Show them where to click, send files both ways, let AI Vision decode and translate errors, and take mouse and keyboard control with a small Windows helper.

records.name: Vasco's Peri Peri
records.tagline: Bold Spice Smoky Flavor Flame Grilled Chicken in Naperville
records.description: Enjoy delicious flame grilled chicken in Naperville at Vasco’s Peri Peri. Experience bold peri peri flavors, smoky grilled chicken, spicy wings, tenders, and satisfying meal options. Perfect for chicken lovers seeking flavorful grilled meals, exciting tastes, and a memorable dining experience with family and friends. Discover our menu and explore the flavors of Vasco’s Peri Peri!

records.name: PureSound
records.tagline: Sleep, find calm or focus to get work done
records.description: PureSound is an iPhone and iPad app that plays nature sounds, white noise, binaural beats, solfeggio tones and music for sleep, calm or focus. Users can create their own soundscapes by mixing and layering sounds in the app.

records.name: dr shakeen
records.tagline: Dr Shakeen Eye & Dental Hospital |
records.description: Dr. Shakeen Eye & Dental Hospital is a trusted centre for advanced eye and dental care in Amritsar, offering comprehensive treatment with experienced specialists and modern technology. From LASIK, cataract, cornea, retina and glaucoma care to dental implants, braces, smile designing, RCT and crowns,

records.name: Makla
records.tagline: Your AI team for smarter, more profitable restaurants
records.description: Makla is an AI-powered intelligence platform for restaurants and cloud kitchens. Ask questions about sales, profitability, costs, VAT, and delivery commissions in natural language. Makla turns complex operational data into clear, actionable insights, helping operators understand what's driving performance and where they're losing money. Unlike generic AI chatbots, Makla checks its answers against available business data, flags missing information, and avoids unsupported conclusions.

records.name: Voice Greeting Studio
records.tagline: AI voicemail greetings and phone menus for any phone system
records.description: Describe your business in one sentence and hear three greeting scripts in a studio voice, free, with no signup. Pick one, add background music, and download the exact file your phone system needs: RingCentral, Teams, Zoom Phone, 3CX and more. $9 a greeting or $29 for a phone menu of up to 20 prompts. No subscription, 30-day refunds.

records.name: Quanta Study
records.tagline: Turn study materials into flashcards, quizzes and podcasts
records.description: Quanta Study turns your PDFs and notes into flashcards, quizzes and learning podcasts with editable scripts. Review with FSRS spaced repetition, practise open-ended answers with an AI exam tutor and plan your study. Create cards manually or import supported Anki text cards. Available source references help you check generated content. Explore a public STEM reference with worked examples, calculators and exercises. Free Starter; ongoing AI features require a paid plan.

records.name: Veytrix Cyber
records.tagline: Cyber Security for GP Clinics & Medical Centres
records.description: Cyber security risk assessments for GP clinics, medical centres and healthcare providers in Sydney. Identify security gaps and protect patient information.

records.name: Spike
records.tagline: Share, protect, and sell files from one link.
records.description: Spike gives creators one place to store, share, and sell their files. Upload a folder, share a protected preview, and let customers unlock original downloads from the same link. Add passwords, blur, watermarks, or content censorship; set folder or per-file pricing; and keep your library organized without relying on expiring transfer links.

records.name: Cow Crust leather supplier Bangladesh
records.tagline: Buying & Inspecting agent of Leather
records.description: Masma Leather World is a premier cow, goat, and buffalo leather exporter and buying agency in Bangladesh, operating from the BSCIC Tannery Industrial Estate in Dhaka since 1996. With 30 years of industry expertise, we connect global brands and manufacturers with top-tier Bangladeshi tanneries and factories.

records.name: Portico 6 Seater Dining Table
records.tagline: Sculptural Mango Wood Dining Table by Orange Tree
records.description: Meet Portico, a six-seater dining table that brings sculptural elegance to everyday living. Crafted from mango wood in a warm Golden Oak finish, Portico features four beautifully turned column supports, softly rounded edges and a distinctive contemporary silhouette. Designed by Orange Tree, it brings together thoughtful craftsmanship, natural materials and timeless aesthetics to create an inviting dining experience.

records.name: Rudopo
records.tagline: Envelope budgeting for money in more than one currency
records.description: Rudopo is an envelope budget for money in many currencies. Each account keeps its own currency, every entry keeps that day's exchange rate, and you plan it all in the currency you think in. Spaces per country, business accounts, no ads or trackers.

records.name: Simflowly
records.tagline: Draw a process, press play, see the bottleneck
records.description: Simflowly turns a process map into a simulation that runs in your browser. See throughput, queues and the bottleneck, compare scenarios with 95% confidence intervals, and share a report. Free plan, free calculators, and the engine validation is published.

records.name: ipvolt
records.tagline: Rent a mobile proxy for a day, from $9. No account needed.
records.description: ipvolt sells proxies for developers. Dedicated mobile proxies are real devices on carrier networks in 12 countries, rented for a day from $9 or 30 days from $100, with no traffic limit and IP rotation on demand. You can buy without an account. Shared mobile and residential proxies are billed per GB in prepaid packs from $5. Everything works over HTTP and SOCKS5. Pay with crypto; nothing renews automatically. Free tools include a proxy checker and an MCP server for AI coding agents.

records.name: Steer Wrestling AI Video Generator
records.tagline: Turn one portrait into a 15-second rodeo film
records.description: Turn one adult portrait into a 15-second vertical rodeo film: horseback approach, dismount, dirt slide and sporting takedown. Preview the AI example, choose a quality tier and add optional arena ambience. The template supplies the western outfit, animals and arena. Built with Viral Video AI; generation uses credits.

records.name: Dawn of War 4 FPS calculator
records.tagline: Dawn of War 4 FPS calculator
records.description: Check what FPS your PC will get in Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV. Free estimator with GPU, CPU, RAM and preset options. Releases Dec 3, 2026.

records.name: Sysinfo Pegasus Mail Converter Tool
records.tagline: Convert Pegasus Mail Data to Multiple File Formats
records.description: The Pegasus Mail Converter Tool is the most advanced solution to convert Pegasus files to various file formats. Download the Free Pegasus Converter Tool.

records.name: Pawmoku
records.tagline: A daily cats vs dogs logic puzzle
records.description: Fill a grid with cats and dogs using two rules: equal numbers in every row and column, and never three matching animals in a line. Play the shared daily, choose a team, or explore hundreds of Journey levels. For iPhone, iPad and Android. No ads or subscriptions. Optional Treats never buy a team win. Try a practice puzzle in your browser.

records.name: weedit Gift Wrap & Message
records.tagline: Sell gift wrap and collect gift messages right in the cart
records.description: Shoppers check a box to add your own gift wrap product to the cart, at the price you set, one per cart. They can also write a gift message with optional To and From fields. The message is saved with the order under Additional details. Both show on the cart page and in the cart drawer. Placement is built in for Dawn and Horizon; for other themes there is a placement setting and an app block. On product pages, “Buy it now” and express checkout buttons skip the cart and the gift options.

records.name: Get my Money Back Agent
records.tagline: Turn a bad purchase into a firm, polite complaint
records.description: Turn a bad purchase into a firm, polite complaint and a plan to get paid.

records.name: Digital Product Seller Content Pack
records.tagline: 14 JPG visuals and content ideas for digital product sellers
records.description: A $19 one-time download for digital product sellers: 14 flat JPG visuals covering content planning, pricing, objection handling and launch ideas. These are flat images, not editable templates. Adapt example text to your own offer. Gallery images are illustrative marketing artwork, not exact previews of every downloadable page.

records.name: WinStudio
records.tagline: Record and edit beautiful screen recordings on Windows
records.description: WinStudio lets you record your screen and turn it into a polished demo, right in your browser. Add zoom effects to highlight the details, make clicks easier to follow with cursor effects, choose a background, and trim the pauses before exporting. I’m still improving it and would love your honest feedback. If you were recording a demo of your project today, what would make the process easier?

records.name: digdns — Health check
records.tagline: Free one-click full check of a domain
records.description: Free one-click full check of a domain: DNS, DNSSEC, SSL certificate, HTTPS, email security (SPF, DMARC, DKIM), blocklists and expiry, with a score out of 100 and a list of fixes.

records.name: ArmPOS
records.tagline: Smart POS & Inventory Management for Growing Businesses
records.description: ArmPOS is a cloud-based POS and inventory management system built to help businesses simplify sales, track stock, and manage daily operations. Whether you run a retail shop, supermarket, minimart, or wholesale business, ArmPOS helps you monitor inventory across branches, manage products, and track business performance from one platform. Get better visibility into your operations and make smarter business decisions with a simple, accessible solution.

records.name: 24/7 Heatmap
records.tagline: Stock heat map that keeps updating after hours and weekends
records.description: A free live S&P 500, Nasdaq-100 and Dow 30 heat map that keeps updating after hours, overnight, premarket and on weekends. Tiles are sized by market cap and colored by the move since the previous close. Custom maps and an installable app. No account needed.

records.name: Retail Sales Data Cleaner
records.tagline: Instant ETL CSV cleaner with 30s auto-purge & analytics
records.description: Drop messy retail sales CSVs and get cleaned, profiled, and sanitized data in seconds. Built with FastAPI, Pandas, Neon PostgreSQL, and Next.js—featuring zero-signup Guest Mode (with automatic 30-second database TTL purge), idempotent cloud upserts, and Excel formula-injection protection.

records.name: Odds Outs poker odds simulator
records.tagline: Poker Odds Calculator & Simulator for Every Player
records.description: Every poker calculator compares two hands. Real hands have three players, a card you half-saw, and a friend who bluffs too much. Odds Outs is a free Texas Hold'em simulator for the whole table: up to 9 players, cards hidden, half-shown or shown, bets and player styles. It shows everyone's equity, your outs, and what each opponent is likely holding. Plus 80 guides to odds, outs, reads and home games, each with a hand you can replay. No sign-up, no gambling.

records.name: Statistics Calculator Suite
records.tagline: Free Online Statistics Calculator Suite (No Signup)
records.description: Free comprehensive statistics calculator for mean, median, mode, standard deviation, variance, and more. Includes charts and data visualization.

records.name: ProductToReel
records.tagline: Turn a product link into video ads. Pay per video.
records.description: Paste a product page link or upload 1–3 photos. ProductToReel writes three storyboards (hook, voice-over, shot plan) for free, no sign-up. Pick one and it renders a 12–20-second 9:16 video ad for TikTok, Reels and Shorts: your own product photos animated with AI, voice-over, burned-in captions, music and a call-to-action end card. Four formats: product only, AI presenter, product in a presenter's hand, or faceless AI hands. Pay per video from $2.49. No subscription.

records.name: Thodea
records.tagline: Social platform designed to share thoughts and ideas
records.description: Thodea is an independent social platform and communication ecosystem built to empower human voices and restore meaningful conversation to the internet. In an online landscape increasingly dominated by rage-inducing algorithms, endless doomscrolling, and intrusive data tracking, Thodea offers a calm, privacy-first alternative where people can freelyshare thoughts, explore original ideas, and connect without being treated as a product. Designed around a clean, distraction-free experience

records.name: LokerDollar
records.tagline: Remote jobs that pay in USD, for applicants in Indonesia
records.description: LokerDollar is a job board for people in Indonesia who want remote work paid in US dollars. It lists more than 21,000 remote roles, filtered to roles open to applicants outside the US. Listings link straight to the employer's own application page. The site also publishes salary guides by role, company pages, and a research page on remote hiring. Everything is free for job seekers and available in Indonesian and English.

records.name: AIR Office
records.tagline: Your personal AI safety lab in an app.
records.description: Keep AI safety research, evaluations, and policy work private and structured in one local-first desktop lab. AIR Office combines grounded knowledge management, guardrails, and shareable agent workflows in a free, open-source app for Windows and macOS.

records.name: BandBloom
records.tagline: IELTS & CELPIP practice with progress tracking
records.description: BandBloom is a free language exam preparation platform for IELTS and CELPIP learners. Practise reading, listening, writing and speaking, complete timed exercises, create study plans and monitor your progress in one place. Built for students and prospective immigrants who want accessible, structured exam preparation. BandBloom is currently in early access, and we're looking for learners to test the experience and help shape future features.

records.name: TimerHaven
records.tagline: Minimalist, ad-free focus and interval timer for iOS & Web
records.description: Most timer apps have become bloated subscription machines demanding $5–$10/month just to run a Pomodoro clock, popping up video ads during deep work, or locking interval settings behind paywalls. I built TimerHaven to be the exact opposite: clean, fast, completely free of intrusive ads, and private by design. v1.1.3 brings the suite to iOS with rock-solid background alerts that fire even when your phone locks, customizable work/rest cycles, stopwatch with laps, and no sign-up required.

records.name: EasyToPaste
records.tagline: One-time secret links, encrypted in your browser
records.description: Share a password or API key through a one-time link. Your browser encrypts it; we never receive the key, so we can't read what we store. The record is deleted after first read; an encrypted copy can sit in backups up to 35 days. Free tier, no account needed.

records.name: Webless Agents
records.tagline: Agents you want to put in front of customers
records.description: You wouldn’t put most website chatbots in front of a customer. Webless Agents are different: you describe the outcome you want in plain English, and Webless builds the agent on your published content, so it answers only from what you’ve said. You review every instruction and change anything before it goes live. Then it gets to work: answering questions, qualifying buyers, sending quotes, booking meetings and handing off to your team. For Product Hunt: 3 months of our highest plan, free.

records.name: Naya for Business
records.tagline: Booking software for salons, barbers and solo pros
records.description: Naya gives salons, barbershops, studios and independent pros a booking page where clients see real free time and book on their own. Behind it is one dashboard for the calendar, staff schedules, client notes, memberships, payroll and daily cash. An AI assistant answers questions about your business and changes things only after you confirm, and another one can reply to clients in chat. You pay per location, not per seat, so adding staff costs nothing.

records.name: Voyalys
records.tagline: Assisted Intelligent Travel Planner
records.description: Voyalys is an AI Travel Planer what we call - Assisted Intelligent™ trip planner that builds realistic day-by-day itineraries in seconds. Our algorithms are trained on trips real people have actually taken, so routes and pacing feel doable, not cramped. See live hotel pricing from booking sites and book standalone hotels on Voyalys, or hand off to a human concierge on WhatsApp to refine and book the full trip.

records.name: BudgetClick
records.tagline: Open-source finance planner that only you can read
records.description: BudgetClick is a free, open-source personal finance tracker and planner that fits on one spreadsheet-style screen, with widgets for the big picture. Everything is encrypted on your device with AES-256-GCM before it leaves it, and synced across your devices through a storage bucket you own. Works offline, installs as a PWA, and needs no account and no subscription. Built in public, with the code, docs and architecture walkthrough all open.

records.name: PAEval
records.tagline: Compare personal AI agents with source-linked evidence
records.description: Compare personal AI agents using published benchmarks and documented capabilities. PAEval tracks 88 products and keeps each evaluator’s original scales, samples and configurations visible. Explore side-by-side comparisons, capability evidence and source links. Missing evidence stays explicit. The PAEval Index is in development; no composite ratings are published.

records.name: ISO 11616 Revision Checker
records.tagline: The medicinal product ID change, checked
records.description: The free clause record and scope check for ISO/FDIS 11616, the final draft that replaces ISO 11616:2017. Read all 21 clauses, see the stage timeline, and check whether your product data flow is in scope. The USD 299 kit turns the record into a register with an owner, a due date and an evidence pointer; the USD 29 watch emails the diff when the record changes.
