No certification, no legal advice, and every page says what is public and what is not.

records.name: CarrierScrub
records.tagline: Vet transportation freight carriers in seconds
records.description: Transportation carrier vetting for small freight brokers. Type an MC or DOT number and get a verdict with reason codes from FMCSA's own filings: authority, insurance, safety record, crashes and court cases. A watchlist emails you when a carrier's verdict changes. Three carriers a day free, 25 a month free with an account, then $1.00 each or $79 a month unlimited. API and MCP server available.

records.name: StrataMar
records.tagline: Decision-support software for industrial and corporate teams
records.description: StrataMar develops decision-support software for industrial and corporate teams. Explore alternative plans, compare trade-offs, check operational constraints, and review decisions before taking action. Our interactive treasury demo shows how a delayed customer payment affects cash planning and how different responses change the outcome. Built around transparent workflows, scenario analysis, and human approval.

records.name: Alertsify Trade
records.tagline: Copy trading for new traders, with verified stats
records.description: Alertsify Trade helps new traders place trades in seconds, copy the traders they choose, and track results automatically. Build consistency with verified stats. Try it free for 7 days. Trading involves risk.

records.name: Hakanow
records.tagline: Run hackathons builders love, from sign-up to prizes
records.description: Hakanow is where builders find hackathons and organizers run them. Hackers discover events, register, form teams and submit. Organizers watch it all live, judges score on a weighted rubric, and every prize is tracked until the winner confirms it.

records.name: Lopaw
records.tagline: AI trainer for dog separation anxiety, one session a day
records.description: Lopaw is an AI trainer for dogs that panic when left alone and bark, howl or scratch at the door. It follows the method dog trainers use. You leave for a time your dog can handle and add a little each day. Every day Lopaw tells you what to practice, you report how your dog coped, and it makes the next session harder, the same or easier. A spare phone lets you watch your dog live while you are out. On iPhone, Android, Apple Watch and Wear OS. The first training day is free.

records.name: Adowise
records.tagline: Build Your Presence Monetize Your Expertise
records.description: Adowise is a platform that helps creators and professionals turn their expertise into a digital business. Creators can offer 1:1 services, sell digital products and courses, host webinars, and earn through brand sponsorships. Businesses use Adowise to run campaigns, discover creators, and manage brand sponsorships.

records.name: Nodeslate
records.tagline: Type it, it draws. Review AI code changes visually
records.description: Nodeslate is the shared picture your backend never had. Type one line per step and it draws mind maps, flowcharts, architecture and database diagrams for you. AI now writes code faster than anyone can review it, so Nodeslate shows each change on the diagram: new steps in green, removed ones struck through. Comment on the exact box, approve it like a pull request, and keep it in sync with your code over MCP (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code). Free to start.

records.name: Blankly
records.tagline: An English workbook that teaches by filling in the blanks
records.description: Blankly is an English grammar workbook for Turkish speakers. 120+ topics and about 24,000 exercises, a short placement test, gentle hints instead of red error screens, a mistake notebook and spaced repetition. On iPhone and Android.

records.name: Speak Teleprompter
records.tagline: Video Teleprompter with Voice-Follow Scrolling
records.description: Video teleprompter for iphone that follows your voice. the script scrolls as you speak, you record on the front camera, and it works in 11 languages. free to try, no account needed.

records.name: Orbit Networker
records.tagline: Capture, follow up and sync every contact you meet
records.description: Networking is how salespeople, agents and founders win clients, but most of it slips through the cracks after the handshake. Orbit covers the whole life cycle. Scan a card or record a voice note, and Orbit builds the contact, files them under the event and keeps what you talked about. Your follow-up is already written for SMS, email or LinkedIn, and contacts sync both ways with your CRM. Log the outcome and deal value, then see which events paid off on the web dashboard.

records.name: Kore Keihi? — Expense Checker for Japan
records.tagline: Can you expense it? 1,258 Japanese expenses, judged.
records.description: A free tool for freelancers and sole proprietors in Japan. Search any business expense and get a clear verdict — deductible, conditional, or not deductible — with the reason, a usage example that makes it OK, and the right accounting category. 1,258 items across 72 categories, including pre-opening costs, food trucks, e-invoicing rules and corporate cases. Missing an item? Request it via X DM (@moko_works_jp) and we add it. No sign-up, free. Made by Moko Works.

records.name: CuisineBlend
records.tagline: what's your food mood today?
records.description: CuisineBlend - food. stories. choices. key features include... Chat – Culinary Assistance with AI; Discover – Dining and Restaurants; Explore – Trends and Experiences; Customized – Personalized Meals;
